title: Coding Club Ecosystem Map
description: Place a coding club precisely among six neighbouring educational contexts, and see what makes it distinct from each one.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Chapter 1: What Is a Coding Club

educational.audience: Coding club leaders, mentors, and prospective sponsors

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a set of related program types, the learner distinguishes what makes a coding club distinct while recognizing legitimate overlap.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click-to-explore concept map with labelled relationships and a per-node difference statement
pedagogical.assessment: Name a real local program and ask the learner to place it on the map and defend the placement.
